note: Read this week's GA4 booking numbers as broken, not as demand. The GA4 event sevenrooms_booking_complete stopped firing across all three USA properties part way through Thursday 15 October. Market create-path bookings by day were 74, 65, 64 and 50 on 12 to 15 October and then 2, 2 and 1 on 16, 17 and 18 October. Sessions on those three days were normal, SevenRooms recorded 125 website bookings and 378 website covers over the same three days, and Meta's Schedule conversion rose week on week at every venue, so the bookings happened and GA4 did not record them. The week's GA4 total of 258 therefore covers four days of tracking, not seven, and every GA4 figure on this page, including the week on week and year on year columns and the year to date, understates the market by roughly three days. The covers report is the usable read of the week. This is also the first USA week on the create-path booking definition. From the W37 run, GA4 bookings count only the create path and exclude the modify, manage and prearrival pages, where the same event fires when a guest amends a booking. The amendment share this week was 5.5 percent of all booking events across the market, 0 percent at Aqua NYC, 8.2 percent at Hutong NYC and 18.4 percent at Hutong Miami. In the year-ago week it was 16.7 percent at Aqua NYC and zero at both Hutongs, because in October 2025 the event still fired on the /reservations/<venue> landing route and no modify event existed there. The prior week, the year-ago week, the eight-week series and the year to date have all been rebuilt on the create path so both sides match, which means they do not tie to the figures published up to and including w2026-10-05. The prior week reads 390 rebuilt against 420 published, and the year to date 18,681 against 20,104 published to 11 October. One further correction at Aqua NYC. In the year-ago week its GA4 property also recorded 73 booking events on Hutong New York reservation pages, which are counted again in the Hutong New York property, so Aqua NYC is restricted to its own venue paths in both years. The 2026 week has no such rows. Hutong NYC still has no usable last-year comparison. The site's SevenRooms tracking stopped on 22 September 2025 and resumed on 15 October, so the year-ago week carries only 15 to 19 October, five of seven days and 163 bookings, and it is withheld rather than shown. The portfolio year-on-year column therefore sets three venues this year against two last year. Like for like, Aqua NYC and Hutong Miami booked 191 against 353, and even that comparison is missing three days of this year's tracking. USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, Hutong NYC explicitly so, and Hutong Miami's GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan (monthly × 6738/4756). This week sits wholly inside October, so the weekly target is not pro-rated across months: it is each venue's October GA4 target × 7/30, giving Aqua NYC 559 (2,394 on that basis), Hutong NYC 490 (2,100) and Hutong Miami 124 (530, derived), 1,173 for the market. The USA year-to-date target is not reproducible from the workbook by any day-count rule tested, so it is extended from last week's published cumulative by this week's target, as in prior weeks. Google booking conversions and modelled store visits settle upward for two to three weeks and have done so again: last week's readings moved from 15.0 to 20.0 at Aqua NYC, 21.96 to 22.96 at Hutong NYC and 13.0 to 18.0 at Hutong Miami, so this week's counts are a floor and the paid cost per booking a ceiling. The Google Reserve to OpenTable shift at both US Hutongs remains a routing and margin change, not lost demand.
